text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Government will hold an economic and social conference in the next few days. Critics question the usefulness of holding a five-day conference if the 400 officials attending will have only the choice of rubber-stamping a prepared five-year economic plan.

- Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf says Arab countries' reconciliation, inauguratated at the Arab Summit in Cairo in June, is continuing, even if timidly. Attaf says Arabs reached consensus over Iraq and all stress Iraqi unity should be respected. Algeria took over the Arab League chairmanship this week for the next six months.
- Attaf says Algeria is not thinking to normalise ties with Israel as long as Palestinian, Syrian and Lebanese territories remain occupied by Israel.
- The former ruling National Liberation Front (FLN) holds a central committee meeting on October 2 and 3.
